description: This file defines the MaintenanceService class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for handling maintenance-related operations such as fetching purgeable entities, retrieving access strategies, and accessing employee data with GDPR considerations.
external_files:
OrangeHRM	op of class
OrangeHRM	o maintain access strategies, DAO, ORM, exceptions, and YAML parsing

classes.name: MaintenanceService
classes.description: Service class that manages maintenance operations, including retrieving purgeable entities, dynamic access strategy instantiation, and employee data access within transactions.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Reads and parses a YAML configuration file to obtain a list of entities marked as purgeable.

methods.name: getAccessStrategy
methods.description: Dynamically instantiates and returns an access strategy object based on the provided strategy name and info array.

methods.name: accessEmployeeData
methods.description: Retrieves employee data securely within a database transaction, applying multiple access strategies to obtain data based on GDPR rules.

methods.name: getMaintenanceDao
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and returns the DAO responsible for maintenance database operations.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Delegates extraction of employee-related data from the database based on employee number and table name.
